_comment: Known SDK gaps. vectors: an adapter case reports KNOWN only when its failure has exactly the listed signature (fields: output fields that differ; error: error type; unexpectedOk: signed or decoded what it must refuse; unsupported). node: a node case reports KNOWN only when its problems are exactly the listed ones. Any other failure fails, and so does a listed case that passes, so fixes get unlisted.
